# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 99 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 51 | Coptic

---

## Saying 99

The disciples said to him: "Your brothers and your mother are standing outside." He said to them: "Those here who do the will of my Father — they are my brothers and my mother. It is they who will enter the kingdom of my Father."

---

**Translator's Notes (LOGOS):**

- "They are my brothers and my mother" — the identification stated directly
- "It is they who will enter" — emphatic identification with the eschatological promise
- The order (brothers/mother) follows the Coptic
